tools.label: Net domain
tools.handler: () => { setRightOpen(true); setEmiSection("domain"); setSelectionFilter("net"); setStatus("Select candidate and return nets in the EM setup dock"); }

tools.label: Ports
tools.handler: () => { setRightOpen(true); setEmiSection("excitation"); setStatus("Configure explicit conductor-to-conductor ports in the EM setup dock"); }

tools.label: Domain mesh
tools.handler: () => { setRightOpen(true); setEmiSection("solver"); setStatus("Configure frequency, boundary, and mesh controls in the EM setup dock"); }

tools.label: Near field
tools.handler: () => setStatus("Near-field visualization requires a completed compatible field result")

tools.label: Far field
tools.handler: () => { setEmiDashboardOpen(true); if (emergePatterns.length) { setEmiChamberOpen(true); setStatus("Showing the EMerge radiation pattern in EM"); } else setStatus("Showing the completed openEMS NF2FF radiation result"); }

tools.label: Hover probe
tools.handler: () => setProbeMode(current => { const next = current === "hover" ? "off" : "hover"; setStatus(next === "hover" ? "Hover probe active: move across the board for live measurements" : "Hover probe disabled"); return next; })

tools.label: Duplicate
tools.handler: () => selected ? addProbe({ ...selected, id: `${selected.id}-copy`, name: `${selected.name} copy` }) : setStatus("Select a probe location before duplicating")

tools.label: Impedance
tools.handler: () => { setProbeKind("impedance"); setStatus("Impedance hover requires an AC or parasitic result"); }

tools.label: Print / PDF
tools.handler: () => { generateReport(); setStatus("Report preview ready; choose Print for printer or PDF output"); }

items.label: Print or export report
items.handler: () => { generateReport(); setStatus("Report preview ready; choose Print or Export HTML"); setMenu(null); }

items.label: Report bug
items.handler: () => { setMenu(null); void openBugReport(tab).catch(() => setStatus("Could not open the bug report. Visit github.com/wayri/SPIKE-Main/issues/new")); }
